stemMd: A rack has five positions in a row. A red tube must be immediately to the left of a blue tube. A green tube occupies the middle position. The other two positions contain white tubes. How many placements of the red-blue pair are possible?
explanationMd: Possible adjacent position pairs are 1–2, 2–3, 3–4 and 4–5. The green tube at position 3 excludes the middle two pairs. The red-blue order is fixed, leaving exactly 1–2 and 4–5.

distractorRationale.c: A pair involving the occupied middle position is not allowed.
distractorRationale.d: This counts all adjacent pairs before excluding the green tube.
distractorRationale.e: A two-position adjacent pair cannot start at every position.
